confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Taipei prices at roughly 31-32 TWD per USD; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies by district and season. Cocktail and wine are bounded by Taipei's typical beer and restaurant price levels. The FX value comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, which I did not open directly; a conflicting 16 Oct aggregator figure (0.6947) was not used because the RBA-labelled 15 Oct observation is the latest RBA date reported.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is East Asian mid-sized to large cities with comparable food, cafe, and hotel price levels, such as Seoul and Osaka, adjusted to Taipei's generally lower restaurant and mid-range hotel prices.
